items.description:

Dry and bright with sunny spells. Light to moderate north-westerly winds backing southwest and freshening later, maximum temperature of 9°C. Turning cloudier overnight, with the chance of a few showers, moderate to fresh southwest winds and minimum temperatures of 3 or 4°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 9°C

##Tomorrow##

Often cloudy with a few showers, but also some bright or sunny intervals developing at times. Becoming dry later in the afternoon and evening. Fresh to strong mainly southwest wind and a top temperature of 11°C.

##Sunday, 15 November 2026##

Occasional rain, heavy at times. Fresh to strong mainly southwest wind, veering north or northwest and strengthening further later in the day or evening. Highest temperature 10°C.


##Temperature##

10-20

South or southwest 20-25, occasionally 32 at first, veering west or southwest 15-20 later in the morning, veering north or northwest 20-32 later in the afternoon or evening, perhaps increasing 35-40 with gusts 45-50 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Perhaps gales later. Risk of heavy rain.


##Monday, 16 November 2026##

Bright or sunny spells as well as a few showers at times. Fresh to strong west or northwest wind, steadily easing. Top temperature of 8°C.

##Tuesday, 17 November 2026##
